webResults.content: Cimarex Energy Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend Cimarex Energy Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend News provided by Cimarex Energy Co. Feb 20, 2019, 16:04 ET Share this article Share toX DENVER, Feb. 20, 2019 /PRNewswire/ -- Cimarex Energy Co. (NYSE: XEC) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $0.20 per share, an 11 percent increase from the previous dividend. The dividend is payable on May 31, 2019, to stockholders of record on May 15, 2019.
